verses.yusufAli: What is the (Day) of Noise and Clamour

verses.t: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity
verses.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Calamity is
verses.yusufAli: And what will explain to thee what the (Day) of Noise and Clamour is
verses.rodwell: Who shall teach thee what the Blow is
verses.sale: And what shall make thee to understand how terrible the striking will be

verses.t: It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed
verses.pickthall: A day wherein mankind will be as thickly-scattered moths
verses.yusufAli: (It is) a Day whereon men will be like moths scattered about
verses.rodwell: The Day when men shall be like scattered moths
verses.sale: On that day men shall be like moths scattered abroad

verses.t: And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up
verses.pickthall: And the mountains will become as carded wool
verses.yusufAli: And the mountains will be like carded wool
verses.rodwell: And the mountains shall be like flocks of carded wool
verses.sale: and the mountains shall become like carded wool of various colours driven by the wind

verses.t: Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds]
verses.pickthall: Then, as for him whose scales are heavy (with good works)
verses.yusufAli: Then, he whose balance (of good deeds) will be (found) heavy
verses.rodwell: Then as to him whose balances are heavy
verses.sale: Moreover he whose balance shall be heavy with good works

verses.t: He will be in a pleasant life
verses.pickthall: He will live a pleasant life
verses.yusufAli: Will be in a life of good pleasure and satisfaction
verses.rodwell: his shall be a life that shall please him well

verses.t: But as for one whose scales are light
verses.pickthall: But as for him whose scales are light
verses.yusufAli: But he whose balance (of good deeds) will be (found) light
verses.rodwell: And as to him whose balances are light
verses.sale: But as to him whose balance shall be light

verses.t: His refuge will be an abyss
verses.pickthall: A bereft and Hungry One will be his mother
verses.yusufAli: Will have his home in a (bottomless) Pit
verses.rodwell: his dwelling-place shall be the pit
verses.sale: his dwelling shall be the pit of hell

verses.t: And what can make you know what that is
verses.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what she is
verses.yusufAli: And what will explain to thee what this is
verses.rodwell: And who shall teach thee what the pit (El-Hawiya) is
verses.sale: What shall make thee to understand how frightful the pit of hell is

verses.t: It is a Fire, intensely hot
